name: Himuro Gelato
description: Himuro Gelato is a calm, editorial WordPress theme designed for an artisan gelateria in Larkhaven's Harbour Quarter. Built with refined serif typography and documentary film-grain imagery, it presents daily four-litre batches and tub set-asides through a measured single-column layout. The design features clear pacing, structured product viewers, and dedicated templates for independent makers.

summary.en: Gelato cafe theme: a film-grain photograph that melts into paper under a full-width pale wordmark, a pinned flavour viewer with a spec box, a lit-row batch band on dark grain and a grain-wave footer.
